scope_note: A facsimile of the movement's printed invitation to the President of the RSFSR to its second congress (an archival copy published by the Yeltsin Center as Ф. 6. Оп. 1. Д. 222. Л. 129). The card prints the congress's days but no year and no date of issue; the signature is not printed as a name. The recorded identity is a raw Internet Archive capture made before the cutoff, byte-identical to the live static file. The file name's 19911109 is the host's catalogue date, used only for the naming pattern; it is not a structured date.

edition_and_host.edition: Facsimile of an archival copy, 1 leaf (handwritten leaf number 129 in a case of invitations to the President of the RSFSR): a printed invitation card of the movement, signed by hand under the printed 'Координационный Совет Движения “Демократическая Россия”'.

Ельцина (Yeltsin Presidential Center, a nonprofit foundation): facsimile PDFs (page images, no text layer) of copies of documents of the Archive of the President of the Russian Federation, fund 91 op. 1, catalogued by the Center as 'Ф. 6. Оп. 1'. The PDFs are static files (fixed Last-Modified and ETag); the item description pages (yeltsin.ru/archive/paperwork/<id>/) are dynamic and are locators only.

visual_review.method: The one-page facsimile was rendered from the recorded bytes and read from the image (no text layer), with the signature corner enlarged.

rows.role_title_as_printed: The signature is not printed as a name.
rows.text: A printed invitation card, its printed 'Уважаемый' completed by hand 'Борис Николаевич!': 'Движение "Демократическая Россия" приглашает Вас принять участие в работе второго съезда движения. Съезд состоится 9-10 ноября в помещении киноконцертного зала "Октябрь" (Новоарбатский проспект).', signed by hand under the printed 'Координационный Совет Движения “Демократическая Россия”'.
rows.locator: Leaf 129 (facsimile p. 1): the card and its signature

bounded_scope: Democratic Russia movement and Soyuz deputies' group observations for CLAUDE-C01-35 only. Founding, selection or election, statements, nominations, registration, leadership references by other deputies, membership statements and in-office attestations stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. Co-chairs are recorded as co-leadership, one person per holder observation. State offices, the CPSU, russia.json and the simulation's party rows are outside this extract.
